mapper.insert: INSERT INTO detail_score (user_id, best_correct_count, best_answer_time_ms, achieved_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bestCorrectCount}, #{bestAnswerTimeMs}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT s.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, s.best_correct_count AS score, s.best_answer_time_ms AS secondaryScore FROM detail_score s LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.best_correct_count DESC, s.best_answer_time_ms ASC, s.achieved_at ASC
